reference_coordinate_frame: Ego-Vehicle Coordinate System at Camera Keyframe Timestamp (V_ego)

unknown_unobserved_voxels.definition: Spatial volume containing zero physical radar returns. Monocular camera cannot measure dense depth. Strictly unknown / unobserved space; NOT labeled as free or occupied.

radar_supported_voxels.definition: Spatial volume containing physical millimeter-wave radar returns from reference keyframe within grid boundaries.

heuristic_candidate_associated_returns.definition: Radar returns with unique 1-to-1 candidate association in consecutive sweep under exploratory gating. Labeled as heuristic candidate evidence, NOT confirmed tracking.

ambiguous_candidate_returns.definition: Radar returns with multiple candidate associations or destination contention in consecutive sweep under exploratory gating.

isolated_radar_returns.definition: Radar returns with zero candidate associations in consecutive sweep under exploratory gating.

camera_projection_context.source_pipeline: Stage 3 Multi-Sensor Geometric Alignment & Perspective Projection

projects_into_camera_viewport.definition: Radar returns whose 3D coordinate projects geometrically inside CAM_FRONT image bounds (Z_cam > 0, 0 <= u < 1600, 0 <= v < 900). Geometric projection ONLY; does NOT verify optical line-of-sight visibility or absence of occlusion.

outside_camera_viewport.definition: Radar returns whose 3D coordinate falls outside CAM_FRONT image bounds or has Z_cam <= 0.

two_way_cross_tabulation.description: Mutually exclusive and exhaustive cross-tabulation of the 48 radar-supported voxels.

system_limitations_and_scientific_discla: No collision prediction, Time-to-Collision (TTC), or emergency braking thresholds are computed.
No neural semantic occupancy prediction is used; unobserved space is strictly designated UNKNOWN, not free or occupied.
Camera projection represents geometric pinhole ray intersection only and does NOT confirm visual line of sight or absence of foreground occlusion.
Radar Doppler velocity (vx_comp) is a 1D scalar line-of-sight measurement; transverse velocity is unmeasured and 2D velocity vectors are not inferred.
Stage 4B candidate associations are heuristic temporal proximity pairs, NOT certified object tracking tracks.
System is a research prototype for geometric evidence attribution, NOT a safety-certified ADAS system.
